test_case.test_name: Capacity-bounded full-SEL volume and post-reset management recovery
test_case.purpose: Prove the BMC handles an intentionally full SEL at its documented boundary, remains recoverable through the approved MC reset and returns to healthy logging without destroying real evidence.
required_package: BMC/firmware SEL capacity, reservation and overflow policy
Vendor-approved decode of exact NetFn0x0a Cmd0x44 synthetic record
Protected export of all preexisting SEL and unique synthetic marker
Approved MC reset type/reconnect/recovery plus secure IPMI/Redfish and post-evidence cleanup
test_case.test_command: On a dedicated SUT, export real SEL and baseline health; after critical authorization, append only the approved synthetic record under a capacity-derived bound while retaining every response and periodic `sel info`; stop exactly at the signed full/overflow oracle, preserve boundary evidence, execute the separately approved MC reset once, verify reconnect/IPMI/Redfish/logging, then clean/restore SEL only after evidence review.
test_case.expected_result: SEL reaches the documented full boundary predictably without unbounded overwrite; boundary behavior and every synthetic record are auditable; after the approved reset BMC reconnects within timeout, IPMI/Redfish and logging are healthy, and later authorized cleanup restores capacity without losing the preserved real log export.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires approved raw semantics, exact capacity/full behavior, full evidence, one reset/reconnect and complete management/logging recovery. Unknown raw result, unexpected real-log loss, overflow deviation, instability, reset timeout, failed IPMI/Redfish/logging or premature clear fails/blocks per engineer.
safety_gate: Dedicated non-production SUT and export all real SEL before synthetic filling.
Decode/approve the exact raw payload and bound appends from verified capacity.
Separate explicit approval for MC reset and later SEL cleanup.
Stop on boundary/latency/health anomaly; no automatic append/reset/power/retry.
expected_evidence: BMC/SEL identity, capacity and preserved baseline export
Decoded synthetic record and approved bounded plan
Every append plus periodic/full/overflow status timeline
Reset disconnect/reconnect, IPMI mc info, Redfish version/health and logging checks
Authorized cleanup/restoration, final capacity/health and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: Do not clear on failure. Preserve full SEL and management state; use only the approved independent BMC recovery. Cleanup/restoration occurs after adjudication and must not hide the failure.
